parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the need to mimic the Python sqlparse formatter in pure Node ESM, manually parse --a, avoid external dependencies or Python, and place .mjs files under /output.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept overall implementation ownership but split behavior discovery across three direct child agents, then launched a six-child keyword-classification swarm before implementation began.
parallel.implementation: No project implementation was written in /output; the work visible in the timeline was executable probing and child reports about whitespace, CLI, lexing, and keyword classification.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: There was no integration or assembly stage, and artifact validation found no files and no expected test4.mjs entry.
parallel.verification: The run gathered black-box probe evidence but never created a JavaScript candidate to run against the evaluator or sample tests.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out or was cancelled during the keyword swarm with one child aborted, leaving the required implementation and deliverable absent.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same Node ESM, manual CLI, no dependency, and /output/test4.mjs delivery constraints.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single main actor owned the entire attempt and performed local behavior probes, keyword probing, and scratch-script analysis without any subagent delegation.
serial.implementation: The serial actor wrote multiple scratch probe scripts and candidate lists under /workspace/scratch, but did not write the required /output/test4.mjs or supporting modules.
serial.integration_and_delivery: There was no final assembly or artifact placement, and artifact validation found no files and no expected test4.mjs entry.
serial.verification: The serial run verified black-box executable behavior through local probes, but had no JavaScript implementation to test end-to-end.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run also timed out during exploration before a deliverable existed, so its failure was ordinary non-delivery rather than a parallel coordination failure.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had child-agent context boundaries, but the relevant issue was not missing context; it was that all delegated scopes were investigative.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is both_fail, not discordant. Parallel and serial both completed official evaluation with 0 of 161 samples passed because artifact validation found no submitted files and no expected test4.mjs. The concrete task-solving difference is process-level: parallel deferred implementation behind child-agent investigation and a keyword swarm, while serial performed comparable investigation locally; neither produced code.
parallel_contributors: The parallel parent launched probe-only child work and a later keyword swarm before writing implementation files.
The keyword swarm was cancelled with one child aborted and the final artifact directory remained empty.
serial_contributors: The serial main agent explored locally with scratch scripts and keyword probes rather than delegating.
The serial run also ended before writing /output/test4.mjs, so it shared the same deliverable-level failure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: No delivered implementation existed in either mode, so there are no code-level behavioral differences to attribute to ordinary bugs.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No outcome difference; the retained pattern is a realized adverse parallel process consequence rather than an explanation for a pass/fail split.

candidates.reason: The parallel parent retained responsibility for final implementation after probing; the problem is that implementation never started after an investigation phase, not that no owner existed.
No separate component implementations were produced, so there was no completed multi-component integration object left ownerless.
No components or entry-point implementation were ready for final packaging; the missing test4.mjs reflects no implementation, not an unowned assembly step.
The parallel plan had a parent orchestrator for the end-to-end task; it did not assign independent stages while omitting a pipeline owner.
The gate was not one mandatory harness or oracle step; the parent ran a broad multi-agent investigation phase with several independent probes.

Investigators overlapped, but all delegated work was probe-only and productive implementation was deferred until after behavior and keyword discovery. The run was cancelled at the swarm boundary and no artifact was delivered.
candidates.realized_consequence: Parallel consumed the available run in probe-only child phases and an aborted keyword swarm; no implementation was written or artifact delivered.
candidates.near_match_reason: The broad swarm and timeout are visible, but they are downstream of the more specific decision to keep implementation behind a separate investigation phase.

candidates.reason: Implementation started too late because it was deferred behind investigation; that direct pseudo-concurrency boundary is more specific than general critical-path starvation.
The six-child swarm contributed to deadline pressure, but the retained serial-investigation episode explains why all live child work was still research rather than implementation.
No single child had a demonstrably overbroad implementation scope; the only aborted child was one member of a keyword-probing swarm.
The child briefs were intentionally narrow research assignments and told children not to write files; no child produced unusable implementation because a known requirement was omitted.
The delegated tasks were probes, not separately implemented components expected to interoperate, so no missing interface contract produced incompatible code.
The completed child reports reached the parent; there is no evidence that a known finding disappeared through summary or transfer before a wrong action.
Some reports were long, but the parent consumed them enough to launch the next investigation phase; no available handoff is shown as materially unconsumed because of bulk.
No child result described a superseded workspace or requirement state that the parent then acted on incorrectly.
The child reports were not shown to conflict at a parent decision point; the failure occurred before implementation or reconciliation.
The parent never presented the whole task as complete or accepted a partial artifact; the final state was cancellation and missing delivery, not unsupported completion.
There was no replacement child or retry that repeated prior work without inherited checkpoints.

retained_patterns.reason: The parallel parent completed a first probe phase, then launched a second probe-only keyword swarm instead of beginning implementation. Cancellation arrived at that swarm, one child was aborted, and no deliverable was produced.

retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The swarm breadth is real, but the directly corrective boundary is to start implementation before or during investigation rather than treating the issue as fan-out alone.
